title: 第五千六百二十八章 一场复杂的博弈上第五千六百二十七章 太皞部落的反击下
lines: 眼前的血腥厮杀仍在持续进行，太皞部落的年轻弟子们在激战中反而越发斗志昂扬。最初队伍中的配合尚显生涩，阵型也在对手的压力下略显散乱，但随着时间的推移，每个人都迅速适应了战场节奏。彼此之间原本可能互相干扰、步调不一的动作，渐渐融合成协调有序的整体。战友们通过眼神、手势乃至呼吸的默契，在刀光剑影中织成一张无形却坚韧的网。不得不说，在这种生死一线、瞬息万变的残酷战场上，每个人都经历了最直接也最深刻的淬炼。鲜血与汗水交织的经历，危险与压力并存的考验，正以最激烈的方式催动着所有人的成长与蜕变。
已经退到后方静养伤势的太皞青玄，脸上终于在这一刻露出了无法掩饰的狂喜之色。这一次，他真心从太皞部落这批弟子身上，看到了足够令人振奋的希望。或许眼前这群年轻子弟中，大多数人还未重现昔日太皞部落弟子那种叱咤风云、不畏生死的血性与气魄，但他们的成长与蜕变正在以惊人的速度推进，每一次历练、每一次交锋都在让他们迅速脱胎换骨！

眼前的战斗仍旧激烈地持续着，鲜血与死亡随着每一次交手的冲击不断产生，然而随着时间流转，太皞部落的弟子们确实以一种令人瞩目的方式逐渐扭转了整个战局的走向，甚至可以说是完全掌握了这场纷争的主动权与节奏。即便对面联盟军队仍旧一波接着一波地源源不断涌来，但此刻面对着眼前这群越战越勇、气势如虹的太皞部落战士，他们显得镇定而从容，已经彻底摆脱了先前的任何慌乱与紧张，反而在沉稳有序的组织与配合中，展现出一种几乎压倒性的气势与掌控力。

一道道蕴含着古老玄奥之力的阵法不断被太皞部落的精英弟子们合力催动、构建起来，璀璨的阵纹在地面与空中接连亮起，形成坚固的防御与强力的攻击屏障。与此同时，各式各样的珍奇法宝也被弟子们全力灌注灵力，彻底激活开来，法宝的光辉与威能交织闪烁，映照着整个激烈战场。在这一系列强大手段的加持下，战场之上太皞部落一方的弟子们气势如虹，所施展出的术法神通威力剧增，爆发出了远超先前、令人心悸的恐怖杀伤力！不仅如此，随着修为高深、地位尊崇的风凡尘与姜长卿两位强者，各自率领着麾下训练有素的精锐弟子分队，从侧翼果断切入战局、加入战斗，太皞部落一方在战场上的布局与配合顿时更加精妙灵活。得到强力增援后，太皞部落弟子们压力大减，应对敌方攻势时显得愈发从容镇定，掌控战局的能力持续增强，整个战场的态势也由此变得对太皞部落愈发明朗而有利！

敌方联军原本绷紧的阵线，开始在这样狂风骤雨般的攻势下出现裂痕，前排被阵法与法宝击溃的士兵不断后退，连带牵动了后方人马的阵型。先前还整齐划一的冲锋渐渐变得散乱，不少人看着前方步步紧逼、气势越来越盛的太皞战士，眼中已经忍不住生出了退意与惧意。他们原本靠着人多势众抢得先机，本以为能快速碾灭这批年轻的太皞弟子，可万万没有想到，这群年轻人竟能在生死厮杀中硬生生站起来，反而把自己这边打得节节败退。随着风凡尘与姜长卿两支精锐分队不断冲击撕裂阵线，敌方联军渐渐被切割成数个互不相连的小块，陷入了被逐个蚕食的被动局面，败亡的趋势已经清晰地摆在了所有人面前。
就在敌方联军阵脚大乱、士气飞速跌落的时候，立于中军阵后的联军主帅终于按捺不住，提着标志性的玄铁重斧，亲自率领着身边最后的近卫死士往前冲锋，想要在全线崩溃之前重新稳住阵线。可他刚冲过半程，太皞部落早已埋伏在侧的族中长老便纵身跃起，隔着漫天血雾硬生生拦下了他的去路，两柄重器轰然相撞，震得周遭气浪翻涌，直接将周遭缠斗的士兵掀得连连后退。
主帅被拖住脚步，再也无力整饬颓败的阵线，被分割开的联军小块人马在太皞弟子的围堵下，要么放下武器投降，要么被彻底击溃。
然而就在那电光石火的一瞬之间，一声高亢而穿云裂石的长啸陡然从风凡尘口中爆发而出，这啸声仿若九天惊雷，瞬间撕裂了原本凝滞的时空。啸音未落，一阵仿佛源自宇宙洪荒深处的巨大轰鸣便紧随其后，以无可阻挡之势轰然炸响，震彻了整个战场。紧接着，在遥远的天际尽头，大片广袤无垠的璀璨星域仿佛失去了支撑的基石，在令人心悸的力量作用下轰然崩塌、向内坍缩，化作一片吞噬光线的、混乱不堪的虚无深渊。
这惊天动地的异象如同点燃了总攻的烽火，战场上的肃杀气氛骤升至顶点。那由无数宗门、族群集结而成的庞大联军，阵营之中再度爆发出冲天的杀气与灵光，数之不尽、密密麻麻的修士们，脸上带着或决绝、或狰狞的神情，几乎在同一时刻再次催动起各自的法宝、飞剑与符箓。霎时间，万千道流光溢彩、蕴含着毁灭性能量的虹芒，汇成一片铺天盖地的死亡洪流，以排山倒海之势，更为凶狠、更为密集地向着太皞部落弟子所在的阵线悍然冲杀而去！

而面对如此狂暴的攻势，太皞部落一方所展现出的、那股不屈不挠的拼死反击与在绝境中急速发生的惊人蜕变，似乎也完全在联军各方预料与算计之内。他们对此早有准备，甚至像在等待着这一时刻的到来，攻势之中不仅没有半分惊讶与迟滞，反而更添了几分早有预谋的残酷与精准，仿佛一切抵抗与变数，都早已被纳入他们冰冷的战争蓝图之中。

风凡尘衣衫下摆被劲风吹得猎猎作响，漆黑的长发在罡风中狂舞，他周身的空间已经泛起细碎的涟漪，原本缠绕在四肢百骸里的禁制，在这股自星空深处接引而来的磅礴力量冲刷下，正一寸寸崩解碎裂。他垂在身侧的右手缓缓抬起，掌心浮现出一轮暗金色的涡旋，那涡旋中心吞吐着漆黑的光，正是方才远处星域坍缩后引来的虚无之力。联军铺天盖地的死亡洪流转瞬已至身前，太皞部落的阵线上，数千名悍不畏死的战士齐声发出咆哮，将自身精血注入阵旗，撑开了一层翻涌着赤红色斗气的光幕，硬生生挡住了第一波冲击。刺耳的爆响过后，赤色光幕瞬间凹下去大半，裂纹如同蛛网般迅速蔓延，前排十几名战士已经咳血倒飞，却在坠落的瞬间引燃了自身灵脉，化作一团团血雾钻入光幕裂缝，硬生生将崩开的缺口再次补上。风凡尘目光冷冽如冰，扫过联军阵营中那几位躲在后方操控阵势的长老，掌心的暗金色涡旋转速骤然加快，整个人如同离弦之箭，迎着那片死亡洪流悍然冲了上去。

暗金色涡旋所过之处，死亡洪流像是沸水泼雪般消融干净，连带着空间都被虚无之力啃噬出大片空荡荡的裂隙。后方操控阵势的几位长老惊得魂飞魄散，急忙调转阵势，无数道凝练到极致的死光攒射而出，密密麻麻堵死了风凡尘前进的路线。风凡尘不闪不避，周身空间涟漪暴涨，所有死光撞入涟漪之中，瞬间便被涡旋牵引吞噬，连半片冲击波都没能溢出来。眼看风凡尘距离主阵越来越近，一名须发皆白的长老嘶声怒吼，拔出腰间佩刀横劈向自己心口，以自身神魂为引引动阵势核心，整道死亡洪流瞬间缩成一柄数十丈长的漆黑巨刃，带着毁天灭地的气息劈向风凡尘天灵。风凡尘眼底蕴起一丝杀机，掌心涡旋脱掌而出，迎着漆黑巨刃撞了上去，暗金色光晕炸开，巨刃以肉眼可见的速度被啃噬消融，不过短短数息，便只剩半截断刃坠落在阵前，震得整个联军阵营都晃了三晃。那几位长老面如死灰，转身就要遁走，却被涡旋散出的吸力牢牢锁死身形，一点一点拉扯进暗金色的光雾之中，连一声惨叫都没能来得及发出。

解决了阵中长老，风凡尘抬手一引，涡旋倒卷而回落入手心，他纵身跃出碎裂的大阵，抬眼望向联军阵列，原本喧嚷躁动的联军瞬间死寂一片，不少人握着兵器的手掌都控制不住地抖颤。方才那一幕摧枯拉朽的碾压，早已击碎了他们原本攒起的战意，谁也没想到耗费数十年祭炼的死亡大阵，会在短短半刻钟内被人破得干干净净，连主持大阵的长老都没能逃出生天。联军主帅压下翻涌的惊悸，咬着牙挥下佩剑，下令前排的盾阵顶上前压进，试图用人海战术拖死已经接连破阵的风凡尘，可前排的士兵你推我搡，竟没有一人敢率先迈出一步。风凡尘望着阵型松散的联军，唇角勾起一抹淡冷的弧度，掌心暗金色涡旋再次缓缓转动，只等一声令下，便要将这挡路的联军一同扫平。
刹那间，风凡尘悍然出手——抑或说，是他身后那整支执法殿大军随之而动！凛冽的寒芒挟着无尽杀机，宛如骤雨般倾泻而出，瞬息之间便斩灭了无数蜂拥而上的修士。鲜血四溅，哀嚎遍野，整片浩瀚星域仿佛被一层浓重的血色帷幕所笼罩，星光为之黯淡。伴随着一道又一道身影的陨落与破碎，星空间弥漫着死亡的气息。风凡尘目光冷冽如冰，毫不犹豫地率领执法殿弟子如利刃出鞘，直刺战场核心，掀起了一场疯狂而无情的杀戮风暴！

联军的阵线本就因为先前的震慑摇摇欲坠，此刻被风凡尘带头猛冲，顷刻间就撕裂出一道巨大的缺口。后方的联军见缺口被破，士气彻底崩盘，不少人直接扔了兵器转身就逃，原本严整的阵列彻底乱作一团，自相践踏死伤无数。风凡尘踩着满地血污步步向前，暗金色涡旋在他掌心吞吐不定，但凡挡在他身前的人，都被涡旋绞成了飞灰，连魂灵都没能留存下来。联军主帅眼看大势已去，双目赤红提剑朝着风凡尘扑来，想要拼死一搏，可还没等他靠近风凡尘身前三丈，就被一道暗藏的劲气刺穿了胸膛，直直栽倒在血泊里。

结束了当前战局的交锋，风凡尘的视线缓缓投向远方的另一片战场——在那里，由姜长卿率领的重眸一脉弟子正与太皞部落的修士紧密配合，一步步撕裂着敌方的防线。这场冲突本是对方率先来袭，但在姜长卿的战术理解中，却根本没有所谓被动防御的概念。在他看来，唯有持续而强力的进攻，才是瓦解敌人、掌握主动的根本之道。于是，在他果断的指挥下，整个战阵化作一柄尖锐的长矛，不断向前突破；一件件法宝在浩瀚星域间接连祭出，绽放出璀璨夺目的光华，宛若星辰炸裂，照亮了整个战场的每一个角落！

每一次冲击都能在敌阵中撕开更深的豁口，重眸一脉弟子修行的瞳术本就擅长破妄控敌，此刻配合着太皞部落修士刚猛无匹的攻势，刚好将双方的优势发挥得淋漓尽致。被瞳术锁定的敌方修士根本无从躲避，要么被精准击碎法宝，要么直接被重创神魂，还没来得及组织起像样的反扑，就已经倒在了冲锋的路途上。敌方原本依托地势构筑的防线，在这种连绵不绝的猛烈冲击下，正在以肉眼可见的速度不断崩塌，整片战场的胜负走向，已经彻底倒向了太皞部落这一边。

眼看敌方阵线即将彻底崩溃，姜长卿却丝毫没有放缓攻势的意思，他重眸之中灵光翻涌，指尖捏定一道传讯法印，瞬间将指令递到了每一位参战修士的神识当中。整支队伍随即变阵，原先的矛尖攻势骤然分化成三股灵动的游刃，顺着敌方崩塌防线露出的缝隙穿插而入，直接切断了残敌相互驰援的路线，将对手分割成了数个孤立无援的小块。配合着外围不断推进的合围，剩下的残敌只能被困在狭小的星域当中，连转身腾挪的空间都被彻底锁死，只能做最后的困兽之斗。姜长卿本人则纵身掠至阵前，重眸一展，整道目光就像是凝结实质的利刃，直取敌方领命断后的主将，不过瞬息之间就破了对方护身的罡气，直指对方识海。

那敌将惊骇欲绝，想要运转神魂抵抗，却只觉得一股沛然不可抵挡的力量顺着目光闯入识海，不过一息之间，识海核心便被彻底碾碎，连带着整个人的生机都飞快消散，庞大的身躯直直坠向下方破碎的星石。姜长卿收了瞳术，抬手挥出一道灵光，彻底清扫掉小块星域里的负隅顽抗，整个战场的厮杀渐渐平息下来，只余下弥漫不散的血腥味，还在诉说着方才的惨烈。不多时，风凡尘与姜长卿两人遥遥相对，汇聚了所有战力，一同朝着这场大战最核心的枢纽压去——那里，还盘踞着敌方最后一股主力，正等着他们前去了结。

核心星域深处的星空格外死寂，连原本流动的星尘都凝结在了半空，敌方最后那股主力早在先前的拉扯中布下了最终杀阵，暗紫色的毒雾翻涌着遮住了大半天幕，浓郁的煞气几乎要凝成实质，隔着老远都能感觉到刺骨的寒意。风凡尘将暗金色涡旋笼在身前开路，毒雾触碰到光晕便瞬间消融，半点都无法近身，姜长卿则傍在他身侧，重眸不断扫过四周隐伏的陷阱，但凡有暗藏的禁制被他目光扫过，都会瞬间炸裂成细碎的光屑，根本没法阻挡两人前进的脚步。
敌方主将乃是联军牵头的老牌尊者，自从开战以来便一直藏在核心处蓄力，此刻看着两人步步紧逼，他也不再藏拙，一声震耳欲聋的咆哮过后，整座核心杀阵骤然运转，无数根缠绕着剧毒的骨刺从星空深处破土而出，带着腐蚀一切的毒雾朝着两人绞杀而来。风凡尘跨步挡在姜长卿身前，掌心涡旋猛地炸开，化作一张覆盖了半边星空的暗金大网，迎面罩向骨刺，不过瞬息之间，所有骨刺便被虚无之力啃噬得一干二净，连带着附着的剧毒都没剩下半分。
那尊者见状瞳孔骤缩，没想到连压箱底的杀招都被轻易化解，他咬了咬牙，猛地引爆了整个核心杀阵的所有底蕴，自身也化作一道暗紫色的流光，抱着同归于尽的心思朝着风凡尘撞来，想要拉着对手一同陨落在这星域深处。姜长卿早已经将他的动作看在眼里，不等风凡尘出手，他的重眸便已经绽放出冲天灵光，一道凝如实质的金色光束瞬间射出，直直钉在了那尊者的胸口，打断了他自爆的咒语。
风凡尘顺势上前，暗金色涡旋直接贴上了对方的身体，仅仅一个呼吸，那名纵横星域数百年的老牌尊者便连人带罡气被彻底绞碎，连一点残渣都没能留下。

解决掉联军主将之后，整片战场的局势瞬间倒转，没了领头之人压阵，剩下的联军修士早就没了一开始的气势，原本还抱团的阵型很快就乱作一团，不少人直接丢了兵器转头就往星域边界逃。姜长卿抬手收了重眸灵光，目光扫过溃逃的联军，轻声对风凡尘说道：“穷寇莫追，先收了这战场的战利品，稳住咱们占下的星域才是正事。”风凡尘点头应下，随手散去掌心的虚无涡旋，两道传讯玉符已经被他打出去，通知后方的大部队前来接防，两人并肩立在星空之中，看着渐渐平息的烽烟，只待后续部队接手，便可挥军往下一处联军据点进发。
没过多久，后方接防的大部队便循着传讯玉符的标记赶到，一众将士迅速接管了这片刚打下来的星域，清缴残敌、布设防线、清点物资各项事宜都做得井井有条。姜长卿和风凡尘简单交接了战场情况，翻手取出对方留下的纳界袋，从中检出记载了联军布防图的玉简，指尖灵力一引便将玉简送到风凡尘面前，指着图上标记最显眼的一处星域，这一处或许就是这一次联军围杀太皞部落的最后一环！

与此同时，在遥远的地平线处，林铮正迈着沉稳的步伐缓步前行。在他所经路途的这片广阔星域之中，景象已是满目疮痍，绝大部分区域都已在太皞部落的强势横扫之下变得支离破碎、面目全非。更令人瞩目的是，许多按捺不住激动情绪的太皞部落弟子，早就在狂热与亢奋的驱使下，不顾一切地向前冲锋陷阵。然而，所幸有众多经验丰富、修为深厚的太皞部落长老们紧随其后、严密监控，全程保驾护航，因此即便场面一度看似混乱失控，实际上也并未酿成任何不可收拾的意外变故或严重后果。
林铮眉头紧锁，声音低沉而谨慎：“我们必须多加小心，这场胜利来得似乎太过轻易了些，顺利得反而令人心生不安！”他顿了顿，又补充道，“不仅如此，从那些敌人身上缴获的法宝来看，样式陈旧，工艺古拙，不像是他们这个层次该有的装备。”
姜长卿和风凡尘闻言，先是愣了一瞬，随即神色骤变，立刻意识到其中可能藏有隐情。他们不敢怠慢，迅速将林铮的警示传达给太皞部落的每一位长老。两人心中暗忖：林铮的洞察力总是如此敏锐，往往能察觉出众人忽略的细节。此刻细细回想，整场战役的过程确实笼罩着一层难以言喻的诡异氛围，仿佛暗处有目光窥视，又似有无形的丝线在暗中牵引。种种迹象交织，令人不禁脊背发凉。
“那此地去不去？”风凡尘指了指玉简之上的星域坐标，这一处突显的太过扎眼，可是若是就此放弃对于太皞部落刚刚升起的士气绝对是一个打击！

The bloody fight in front of them was still going on, and the young disciples of the Taihao tribe became more and more motivated in the fierce battle. At first, the cooperation in the team was still rough, and the formation was slightly scattered under the pressure of the opponent. However, as time passed, everyone quickly adapted to the rhythm of the battlefield. The movements that might have interfered with each other and were out of step gradually merged into a coordinated and orderly whole. Through the tacit understanding of their eyes, gestures and even breathing, the comrades weave an invisible but tough network amidst the light and shadow of swords. It has to be said that in this cruel and ever-changing battlefield where life and death are on the line, everyone has experienced the most direct and profound tempering. The experience of blood and sweat, the test of coexistence of danger and pressure, is driving everyone's growth and transformation in the most intense way.
Taihao Qingxuan, who had retreated to the rear to rest and recover from his injuries, finally showed a look of ecstasy that could not be concealed at this moment. This time, he really saw enough exciting hope from these disciples of the Taihao tribe. Perhaps most of the young disciples in front of them have not yet reproduced the all-powerful, fearless spirit and spirit of the Taihao tribe disciples in the past, but their growth and transformation are advancing at an alarming rate. Every experience and every confrontation makes them quickly reborn!
The battle in front of them is still fierce, and blood and death continue to occur with the impact of each encounter. However, as time goes by, the disciples of the Taihao tribe have indeed gradually reversed the direction of the entire war in an eye-catching way. It can even be said that they have completely grasped the initiative and rhythm of this dispute. Even though the alliance troops on the opposite side are still coming one after another, facing this group of Taihao tribe warriors who are becoming more and more courageous and powerful as they fight, they appear calm and calm. They have completely got rid of any previous panic and tension. Instead, in their calm and orderly organization and cooperation, they show an almost overwhelming momentum and control.
Formations containing ancient mystical power were continuously mobilized and constructed by the elite disciples of the Taihao tribe. The bright formations lit up on the ground and in the air one after another, forming a solid defense and powerful attack barrier. At the same time, all kinds of rare magic weapons were fully infused with spiritual power by the disciples and fully activated. The brilliance and power of the magic weapons twinkled and shone, reflecting the entire fierce battlefield. With the blessing of this series of powerful means, the disciples of the Taihao tribe on the battlefield were as powerful as a rainbow, and the power of their magical powers increased dramatically, erupting with terrifying and terrifying lethality that far exceeded the previous ones! Not only that, as Feng Fanchen and Jiang Changqing, two powerful men with advanced cultivation and respected status, each led a team of well-trained elite disciples under their command, decisively entered the battle from the flanks and joined the battle, the Taihao tribe's layout and coordination on the battlefield suddenly became more sophisticated and flexible. After receiving strong reinforcements, the Taihao Tribe disciples were greatly relieved and became more calm and calm when dealing with the enemy's offensive. Their ability to control the battle situation continued to increase, and the situation on the entire battlefield became clearer and more favorable to the Taihao Tribe!
The originally tight front line of the enemy coalition forces began to show cracks under such a stormy offensive. The soldiers in the front row who were defeated by the formations and magic weapons continued to retreat, which also affected the formation of the troops behind them. The charge that had been uniform before gradually became scattered. Many people couldn't help but feel retreat and fear in their eyes as they looked at the Taihao warriors who were pressing forward step by step and becoming more and more powerful. They originally relied on the strength of their numbers to seize the opportunity, and thought they could quickly crush these young Taihao disciples. However, they never expected that these young people could stand up in the middle of a life-and-death fight, and instead defeated their own side. As the two elite teams of Feng Fanchen and Jiang Changqing continued to attack and tear apart the front line, the enemy coalition forces were gradually cut into several disconnected pieces, falling into a passive situation of being cannibalized one by one. The trend of defeat was clearly placed in front of everyone.
Just when the enemy coalition forces were in chaos and their morale was plummeting, the coalition commander standing behind the Chinese army's formation finally couldn't hold himself back. Carrying his iconic black iron heavy ax, he personally led the last guards around him to charge forward, hoping to stabilize the front before the entire line collapsed. But just as he was halfway through, the elders of the Taihao Tribe, who had been ambushing him for a long time, jumped up and blocked his way through the bloody mist. The two heavy weapons collided with each other, causing air waves to surge around him, and directly pushed the fighting soldiers around him back.
The coach was held back and was no longer able to straighten out the defeated front. The small group of separated coalition troops, surrounded by Taihao disciples, either laid down their weapons and surrendered, or were completely defeated.
However, in that flash of lightning, a high-pitched roar that penetrated the clouds and cracked rocks suddenly burst out from Feng Fanchen's mouth. This roar was like thunder from the sky, instantly tearing apart the originally stagnant time and space. Before the whistle had subsided, a huge roar that seemed to originate from the depths of the universe followed closely behind, exploding with unstoppable force and shaking the entire battlefield. Immediately afterwards, at the far end of the sky, the vast expanse of bright star fields seemed to have lost the cornerstone of support. Under the action of the heart-stopping force, it suddenly collapsed and collapsed inward, turning into a chaotic abyss of nothingness that swallowed light.
This earth-shattering vision was like the beacon that ignited the general offensive, and the chilling atmosphere on the battlefield suddenly rose to its peak. The huge alliance formed by countless sects and ethnic groups once again erupted with murderous aura and spiritual light. Countless and densely packed monks, with expressions of determination or ferociousness on their faces, activated their magic weapons, flying swords and talismans again at almost the same moment. In an instant, thousands of rainbow lights filled with brilliant colors and destructive energy merged into an overwhelming torrent of death. With an overwhelming force, they charged towards the line of the disciples of the Taihao Tribe with more ferocity and density!

In the face of such a violent offensive, the Taihao tribe's unyielding counterattack and the astonishing transformation that occurred rapidly in a desperate situation seemed to be completely within the expectations and calculations of all parties in the coalition. They had been prepared for this for a long time, and even seemed to be waiting for this moment to come. Not only was there no surprise or delay in the offensive, but it added a bit of premeditated cruelty and precision, as if all resistance and variables had already been included in their cold war blueprint.
The hem of Feng Fanchen's clothes was blown by the strong wind, and his long black hair danced wildly in the strong wind. The space around him was already filled with fine ripples. The restrictions originally entangled in his limbs were disintegrating inch by inch under the majestic force drawn from the depths of the starry sky. He slowly raised his right hand hanging by his side, and a dark golden vortex appeared in his palm. The center of the vortex was filled with dark light, which was the power of nothingness caused by the collapse of the star field in the distance just now. The overwhelming torrent of death from the coalition forces was in front of them in an instant. On the Taihao tribe's front line, thousands of warriors who were not afraid of death roared in unison, pouring their essence and blood into the formation flag, opening up a layer of light curtain filled with crimson fighting spirit, blocking the first wave of impact. After the ear-piercing explosion, most of the red light curtain sank in an instant, and the cracks spread quickly like a spider web. A dozen soldiers in the front row had already coughed up blood and flew backwards, but at the moment of falling, they ignited their own spiritual veins, turned into clouds of blood mist, and penetrated into the cracks in the light curtain, forcibly filling the gap again. Feng Fanchen's eyes were as cold as ice as he glanced at the elders in the coalition camp who were hiding behind to control the formation. The dark golden vortex in the palm of his hand suddenly accelerated, and his whole body was like an arrow, rushing forward against the torrent of death.
Wherever the dark golden vortex passed, the torrent of death melted away like boiling water and splashed snow, and even the space was eaten away by the power of nothingness, leaving large empty cracks. The elders controlling the formation at the rear were so frightened that they hurriedly changed their formation. Countless rays of extremely condensed death light shot out, densely blocking Feng Fanchen's path forward. Feng Fanchen refused to dodge, and the ripples in the space around him skyrocketed. All the dead lights crashed into the ripples, and were instantly drawn and swallowed by the vortex. Not even half of the shock wave could escape. Seeing Feng Fanchen getting closer and closer to the main formation, an elder with white hair and beard roared angrily, pulled out the sword from his waist and slashed at his heart, using his soul as a guide to activate the core of the formation, the entire torrent of death instantly shrunk into a giant black blade tens of feet long, and struck Feng Fanchen Tianling with a breath of destruction. There was a trace of murderous intention in Feng Fanchen's eyes, and the vortex in his palm came out, and he hit the giant black blade. The dark golden halo exploded, and the giant blade was eaten away and melted at a speed visible to the naked eye. In just a few breaths, only half of the broken blade fell in front of the formation, shaking the entire coalition camp. The elders' faces were ashen, and they turned around to run away, but their bodies were tightly locked by the suction force emitted by the vortex, and they were pulled bit by bit into the dark golden light mist, and they didn't even have time to let out a scream.
After taking care of the elders in the formation, Feng Fanchen raised his hand to guide the vortex, and the vortex rolled back into the palm of his hand. He jumped out of the broken formation and looked up at the coalition array. The originally noisy and restless coalition suddenly fell into silence. Many people's palms holding weapons trembled uncontrollably. The crushing scene just now had already shattered their original fighting spirit. No one expected that the death formation that had taken decades of sacrifice would be completely broken in just half a quarter of an hour. Not even the elders in charge of the formation could escape. The coalition commander suppressed the surge of panic, gritted his teeth, waved his sword, and ordered the front row of shield formations to press forward, trying to use the human sea tactic to drag down Feng Fanchen, who had broken the formation one after another. However, the soldiers in the front row pushed each other, and no one dared to take the first step. Feng Fanchen looked at the loosely formed coalition forces, with a cold arc on his lips. The dark golden vortex in his palm slowly rotated again, waiting for an order to wipe out the coalition forces blocking the road.
In an instant, Feng Fanchen took action boldly - or rather, the entire Law Enforcement Hall army behind him moved with him! The biting cold light, carrying endless murderous intent, poured out like a sudden rain, killing countless monks swarming up in an instant. Blood splattered everywhere, wailing was everywhere, and the entire vast star field seemed to be shrouded in a thick blood-colored curtain, and the starlight was dimmed. As figures fell and shattered one after another, the starry space was filled with the breath of death. Feng Fanchen's eyes were as cold as ice. Without hesitation, he led the disciples of the Law Enforcement Hall to unsheath their swords and pierce the core of the battlefield, setting off a crazy and ruthless killing storm!
The coalition's front was already crumbling due to the previous shock, but now Feng Fanchen took the lead in rushing forward, tearing a huge gap in an instant. Seeing that the gap was breached, the coalition forces in the rear had a complete collapse in morale. Many people simply threw away their weapons and turned around to flee. The originally neat array was completely thrown into chaos, trampling on each other and causing countless casualties. Feng Fanchen stepped forward step by step on the blood stained ground, the dark golden vortex hesitating in his palm. Anyone who stood in front of him was crushed into fly ash by the vortex, and even their souls were not retained. Seeing that the situation was over, the allied commander's eyes were red and he rushed towards Feng Fanchen with his sword in hand, wanting to fight to the death. However, before he could get even three feet in front of Feng Fanchen, he was pierced through the chest by a hidden force and fell straight into a pool of blood.
After the current battle ended, Feng Fanchen's eyes slowly turned to another battlefield in the distance - there, the disciples of the Chongmu lineage led by Jiang Changqing were working closely with the monks of the Taihao tribe, tearing apart the enemy's defense line step by step. In this conflict, the opponent was the first to attack, but in Jiang Changqing's tactical understanding, there was no concept of passive defense at all. In his view, only sustained and powerful attacks are the fundamental way to disintegrate the enemy and seize the initiative. So, under his decisive command, the entire battle formation turned into a sharp spear, constantly breaking forward; magic weapons were sacrificed one after another in the vast star field, blooming with dazzling brilliance, like stars exploding, illuminating every corner of the entire battlefield!
This chapter is not finished yet, please click on the next page to continue reading the exciting content!
Every impact can tear a deeper gap in the enemy's formation. The pupil technique practiced by the disciples of the Chongmu lineage is good at breaking the illusion and controlling the enemy. At this moment, combined with the fierce and unrivaled offensive of the Taihao tribe monks, the advantages of both sides are fully utilized. The enemy monks who were locked by the pupil technique had no way to escape. They were either crushed by the magic weapon accurately, or their souls were severely damaged. Before they could organize a decent counterattack, they fell on the way to the charge. The enemy's defense line, which was originally built based on the terrain, was constantly collapsing at a speed visible to the naked eye under this continuous and violent impact. The outcome of the entire battlefield had completely shifted to the side of the Taihao tribe.
Seeing that the enemy's front line was about to collapse completely, Jiang Changqing had no intention of slowing down his offensive. The light in his eyes surged, he pinched a communication seal with his fingertips, and instantly delivered the order to the consciousness of every monk participating in the battle. The entire team immediately changed formations, and the original spear point offensive suddenly split into three agile blades, which penetrated through the gaps exposed by the enemy's collapsed defense line, directly cutting off the remaining enemy's mutual aid routes, and dividing the opponent into several isolated and helpless pieces. With the continuous advancing encirclement from the outside, the remaining remaining enemies can only be trapped in a small star field. Even the space for turning and moving is completely locked, and they can only engage in the final fight between trapped beasts. Jiang Changqing himself jumped to the front of the formation, and with a heavy gaze, his gaze was like a sharp blade condensed with essence, directed towards the enemy's general who was leading the way, but in an instant he broke the opponent's protective aura and pointed directly at the opponent's sea of ​​consciousness.
The enemy general was horrified and wanted to use his soul to resist, but he only felt an overwhelming and irresistible force breaking into the sea of ​​​​consciousness following his gaze. However, in just one breath, the core of the sea of ​​​​consciousness was completely crushed, and the whole person's vitality quickly dissipated, and the huge body fell straight towards the broken star stone below. Jiang Changqing withdrew his eye skills, raised his hand and waved a spiritual light, completely clearing away the stubborn resistance in the small star field. The fighting on the entire battlefield gradually subsided, leaving only the lingering smell of blood, still telling of the tragedy just now. Not long after, Feng Fanchen and Jiang Changqing faced each other from a distance, gathering all their fighting forces and pressing together towards the core hub of the war - where the last main force of the enemy was still entrenched, waiting for them to come and end it.
The starry sky deep in the core star field is extremely silent, and even the originally flowing stardust has condensed in the mid-air. The enemy's last main force has already laid out the final killing formation in the previous pull. The dark purple poisonous mist surges and covers most of the sky. The rich evil spirit is almost condensed into substance, and the bone-chilling chill can be felt from a distance. Feng Fanchen enveloped the dark golden vortex in front of him to clear the way. The poisonous mist melted instantly when it touched the halo, making it impossible to get close at all. Jiang Changqing stood beside him, his heavy eyes constantly scanning the hidden traps around him. Whenever there were hidden restrictions that were swept by his eyes, they would instantly explode into tiny pieces of light, unable to stop the two of them from moving forward.
The enemy's leader is a veteran leader led by the coalition forces. He has been hiding in the core to accumulate strength since the war started. At this moment, seeing the two people pressing forward step by step, he no longer hides. After a deafening roar, the entire core killing array suddenly started to move. Countless bone spurs entwined with poison broke out from the depths of the starry sky, and strangled the two people with a poisonous mist that corroded everything. Feng Fanchen stepped in front of Jiang Changqing, and the vortex in his palm suddenly exploded, turning into a large dark gold net that covered half of the starry sky, and faced the bone spurs. However, in an instant, all the bone spurs were eaten away by the power of nothingness, and not even half of the attached poison was left.
Seeing this, the venerable's pupils shrank suddenly. Unexpectedly, even the killing moves at the bottom of the box could be easily resolved. He gritted his teeth and suddenly detonated all the details of the entire core killing array. He himself also turned into a dark purple stream of light, and rushed towards Feng Fanchen with the thought of dying together, wanting to pull his opponent to fall into the depths of the star field. Jiang Changqing had already seen his actions, and before Feng Fanchen could take action, his heavy eyes had already burst into light, and a golden beam of light shot out instantly, nailing the venerable man's chest, interrupting his self-destruction spell.
Feng Fanchen stepped forward, and the dark golden vortex directly pressed against the opponent's body. With just one breath, the veteran venerable who had traversed the Star Territory for hundreds of years was completely ground to pieces, leaving not even a trace of residue behind.
After the alliance leader was eliminated, the situation on the entire battlefield was instantly reversed. Without the leader to control the formation, the remaining alliance monks had long lost their initial momentum. The originally united formation quickly fell into chaos. Many people simply threw away their weapons and fled to the border of the star field. Jiang Changqing raised his hand to close his eyes, glanced at the fleeing coalition forces, and said softly to Feng Fanchen: "Don't chase the poor bandits. First collect the spoils of this battlefield, and then the more important thing is to stabilize the star field we occupied." Feng Fanchen nodded in agreement, and casually dispersed the palms of his hands. In the vortex of nothingness, he had already punched out the two jade talismans, notifying the large forces in the rear to come to take over the defense. The two stood side by side in the starry sky, watching the beacon smoke gradually subside, and only waited for the follow-up troops to take over, before they could march to the next coalition stronghold.
It didn't take long for the large troops coming from the rear to follow the signs of the jade talisman. A group of soldiers quickly took over the newly conquered star field. They cleared away the remaining enemies, set up defense lines, and counted supplies in an orderly manner. Jiang Changqing and Feng Fanchen briefly explained the situation on the battlefield. They took out the Najie bag left by the other party and retrieved the jade slip that recorded the coalition's defense map. With a flick of their fingertips, they sent the jade slip to Feng Fanchen and pointed to the star field with the most conspicuous mark on the map. This might be the last link in the coalition's siege against the Taihao tribe!
At the same time, on the distant horizon, Lin Zheng was walking slowly forward with a steady pace. In the vast star field he passed through, the scene was devastated, and most of the area had been shattered and changed beyond recognition under the powerful sweep of the Taihao tribe. What is even more striking is that many disciples of the Taihao tribe who could not restrain their excitement had already charged forward desperately, driven by fanaticism and excitement. However, fortunately, many experienced and profound Taihao tribe elders followed closely, monitored closely, and escorted the whole process. Therefore, even if the situation seemed chaotic and out of control, it did not actually lead to any uncontrollable accidents or serious consequences.
Lin Zheng frowned, and his voice was low and cautious: "We must be more careful. This victory seems to come too easily, and it is so smooth that it makes people feel uneasy!" He paused, and then added, "Not only that, judging from the magic weapons captured from the enemies, the style is old and the craftsmanship is clumsy. It does not look like the equipment they should have at this level."
When Jiang Changqing and Feng Fanchen heard this, they were stunned for a moment, and then their expressions suddenly changed, and they immediately realized that there might be a hidden secret. They did not dare to neglect and quickly conveyed Lin Zheng's warning to every elder of the Taihao tribe. The two of them secretly thought: Lin Zheng's insight is always so sharp, and he can often detect details that others ignore. Looking back carefully at this moment, the entire battle process was indeed shrouded in an indescribable and strange atmosphere, as if there were eyes peering in the dark, and there seemed to be invisible threads pulling in the dark. All the signs are intertwined, sending chills down one's spine.
"Do you want to go here?" Feng Fanchen pointed to the star field coordinates on the jade slip. This place stood out too eye-catchingly, but if we give up here, it will definitely be a blow to the newly rising morale of the Taihao tribe!
